name: frame-example
comment: Mode (b): a real game frame without depth. Put a screenshot next to this file as frame.png (or point image at it) and give each worm a box [x0, y0, x1, y1] in image pixels (top-left origin) around its body including the head. Depth is faked: an upright capsule per box in front of a far backdrop. Approximate; see README.
